statedAs.text: The following open seasons are restricted to persons who are less than 18 years of age: (d) the open season for hunting blue (Dusky) grouse, spruce (Franklin) grouse and ruffed grouse in M.U.s 3-12 to 3-20 and 3-26 to 3-44 from September 1 to September 9.

statedAs.text: For blue (Dusky), spruce (Franklin) and ruffed grouse, the daily aggregate bag limit is 10.

geography.statedAs: For blue (Dusky), spruce (Franklin) and ruffed grouse, the daily aggregate bag limit is 10.

unresolved: s. 7 applies Part 3 where a Part 1 bag limit carries ***; whether this Part 3 aggregate governs Part 1 items WITHOUT *** is not settled.

Part 1 grouse items 28, 28.1 and 30 print 5(15) without ***; Part 3 s. 2 says 'the daily aggregate bag limit is 10' for blue, spruce and ruffed grouse. Read together they could mean 5 of each species within an aggregate of 10, but no text read states that relation, and s. 7 ties Part 3 to a *** marker these rows do not carry. Unresolved, possibly an EVIDENTIARY_CONFLICT; not decided here.
